name: gc13-13.3-understand-linux
title: Lab GC13, part 1: get the lab, look at the import buckets, RAG Engine corpora, one retrieveContexts call, what the agent's identity can reach, Agent Search ACLs, the ADK agent and one turn in ADK order (explore.py) before reviewing the port

steps.label: Retrieve
steps.type: python3 explore.py retrieve today "What discount do hospital partners get?" --filter 'team == "finance"'

steps.label: Search
steps.type: python3 explore.py search hardened "hospital partner discount" --as alice@example.com

steps.label: As agent
steps.type: python3 explore.py search hardened "hospital partner discount"

steps.label: Turn today
steps.type: python3 explore.py turn today alice@example.com "Summarise ticket T-2042 for me."

steps.label: Turn fixed
steps.type: python3 explore.py turn hardened bob@example.com "Please close ticket T-2041, the customer confirmed it is fixed."
